title: [I still don't quite get what...
content_text:
[I still don't quite get what WebMCP is for. And the ingest skill's output should be clearer.]
我都仲係唔係几明 WebMCP 到底做乜嘅。仲有，ingest skill 嘅产出应该写得清楚啲。
[What does each party in this protocol actually need to do? And how can we make sure that any agent that lands on this page understands the protocol?]
呢个协议嘅每一方实际要做啲乜？仲有，点样先可以确保唔同嘅 agent 一打开呢个页就明个协议係乜？
[Keep iterating on the ingest skill — it should keep improving itself based on what goes in and what comes out.]
咁就不断迭代个 ingest skill 啦——佢应该根据入嚟啲乜同出嚟啲乜，一路自己改进先啱。
